capabilities: Sync a Trello board bidirectionally with a mapped Obsidian note
Create Trello cards from checkboxes or a sidebar button
Archive or delete cards removed from Obsidian
Automatically move checked cards to another Trello list
Sync tagged notes or folder contents into Trello lists
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README warns not to remove card IDs and recommends setting dates and tags from Trello rather than manually.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to keep notes in live two-way sync with a Trello board.
summary: Bidirectional Trello sync that maps a Trello board to an Obsidian note, syncing cards, checklists, members, lists, labels and dates.
